## Summary

Describe what changed.

## Outcome

Describe what changes as a result, including before/after behavior when useful.

## Validation

### Pre-merge acceptance

Describe how the change was validated against mandatory pre-merge criteria, including failures and checks not run. Choose checks using the [test and CI performance principles](https://github.com/takahirox/sandbox/blob/main/docs/development-flow.md#test-and-ci-performance-principles).

### Required post-merge verification

List checks required by this change separately, or state that none are required. Report pending, not-run, or environment-blocked checks honestly; closure does not claim they passed. After merge, record evidence and track discovered defects under the [verification and follow-up guidance](https://github.com/takahirox/sandbox/blob/main/docs/development-flow.md#6-perform-required-post-merge-verification).

## Related issues

Use `Closes #N` for a fully implemented Issue whose mandatory pre-merge acceptance is satisfied, even if post-merge-only verification is pending. Follow the [merge and closure lifecycle](https://github.com/takahirox/sandbox/blob/main/docs/development-flow.md#5-merge).

For intentional partial work, link the parent Issue without a closing keyword and state the remaining scope.
